description: Ex-FAB VC-96 (Boeing 737-2N3) FAB 2115 parked a few metres from the road beside the national park entrance, nicknamed 'Sucatinha'; Aeroin explained its abandonment in Dec 2021 and a Feb 2026 compilation still lists it.
